patterns.pattern: module-scope singleton cache with tenant-blind key
patterns.reasoning: computeCacheKey never includes companyId/instrumentKey/sourceDocumentId; compile.ts:23's defaultCache is a process-lifetime singleton used by every real current caller that omits options.cache. Latent (no app/ route wires this layer yet) but the default behavior the moment it is wired in. Independently corroborated by WS6's executable test (semantic-cache-cross-tenant.test.ts).

patterns.severity: P1 (reconciled to P0 in this audit's certification matrix - see TENANT_INSTRUMENT_ISOLATION_RESULTS)
patterns.reasoning: persistStructuralDefinitions (line 156) and persistDefinedTerms (line 171) both key on companyId+normalizedTerm only. persistDefinedTerms is production-wired (orchestrator.ts:137); two documents in one company defining the same-named term silently collide onto one DB row with a documentId/sourceNodeId mismatch.

patterns.pattern: cross-document fallback in resolveBaseText's DEFINITION branch
patterns.reasoning: index.getDefinition(group.ref, baseDocumentId) ?? index.getDefinition(group.ref) - the no-documentId fallback silently returns any other document's same-named definition with no ambiguity signal.

patterns.pattern: missing per-item fault isolation in persistStructuralReferences
patterns.reasoning: No try/catch around the per-reference prisma.contractReferenceEdge.create call, unlike discovery/pipeline.ts's Phase 2F.2 per-section isolation; a single stale nodeId throws an uncaught FK violation that can abort the whole references-persistence step for a document.

patterns.pattern: array[0] pick on a genuinely multi-valued field (originatingStructuralNodeIds)
patterns.reasoning: bundle.originatingStructuralNodeIds can be multi-valued; auditContextCoverage is only ever called for index [0], silently under-auditing coverage for any additional originating node. Same shape as the nodeKey bug 3F.1.2 fixed elsewhere, here reduces audit completeness rather than corrupting persisted data.

patterns.pattern: semantically-implausible parent/child nesting undetected (rank-distance not checked)
patterns.reasoning: Every I-check validates span containment/existence, none validates nodeType-rank distance; a CLAUSE whose parentNodeId points directly at an ARTICLE produces zero health findings.
OVERLAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE_SPAN only fires for parent/child containment violations; two SIBLING nodes with overlapping charStart..charEnd produce zero health findings.
Every catch block audited degrades to a FAILED/REVIEW_REQUIRED status with the real error message preserved (never a silent console.log-only swallow).
The only hit repo-wide: useLlmAdversarialPass ?? true defaults to MORE verification (the conservative direction), not a permissive shortcut.

Every module-scope Map/Set/Record found is a frozen vocabulary/config table built once from literal values - none is ever .set()-mutated at runtime with request-scoped keys. Contrast with cache.ts's defaultCache, which IS mutated at runtime and IS flagged above.
Field is documented as used ONLY for provenance/audit, never as a retrieval signal, and confirmed never read anywhere in lib/ or app/ - currently inert.

Every hit is either (a) a historical evidence-citing doc-comment explaining why a GENERALIZED pattern exists, matching the Architecture Invariants doc's own carve-out, or (b) the one declared-but-unread provenance field noted above.
